Explanation:  
The question asks for the director of the game that won the D.I.C.E. Award for Game of the Year twelve years before Mass Effect 2 (i.e., in 1999). The Ground Truth Answer is "Martin Hollis," who was the director of GoldenEye 007, the actual Game of the Year winner at the 2nd D.I.C.E. Awards. The Predicted Answer incorrectly identifies the game as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and its director as Shigeru Miyamoto. Therefore, the substance and correct answer provided in the Ground Truth are not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
